Thanks for the crash report, @klob77 — the auto-generated stack trace made this one quick to pin down.

**Root cause:** the bundled `ObjectListView` library was built with `AssemblyVersion("2.9.3.*")`. The `*` wildcard generates a new build/revision number on every compile, and `mRemoteNG.exe` embeds a *strong* reference to the exact version it was compiled against.
